snapshot_policy.chronology_rule: Each reconstructed projection may use only games completed before the target week; same-week and future rows are forbidden.

decomposition.performance_variance: Pregame football-side variance from the walk-forward player/position historical prior.
decomposition.projection_bias: Mean forecast residual on the tuning window; diagnostic only in Step 2H and not automatically applied to future means.
decomposition.projection_error_variance: max(0, residual_variance - mean(performance_variance)) on the tuning window.
decomposition.independence_assumption: The quadrature decomposition is an approximation; aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty are not perfectly identifiable from outcomes alone.
